item.title: Independent inventions in the digital era – local inventions for global innovations?
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the phenomenon of independent inventions occurring in the digital age, examining how localized technological innovations might contribute to global innovation ecosystems. The collection seeks to understand the mechanisms, drivers, and implications of parallel or simultaneous inventions emerging across different geographic regions and technological contexts in contemporary digital environments.
